verses.1: She saw everything with her eyes, heard everything with her ears, and understood everything.
verses.2: As you know, I also know that I will not fall from there.
verses.3: But I, El-Shadai, will speak and reveal it to Eil Ekhp’t.
verses.4: But you are all deceivers and liars. You all are like Elil’s healers.
verses.5: Who will give the seed its growth? May it become wisdom for you.
verses.6: Please listen to my words. Let your ears listen carefully to what I say.
verses.7: Let them speak with arrogance, and let them speak in a way that is full of pride.
verses.8: Their faces will be turned away if there is a dispute.
verses.9: It’s better if they investigate you. If you act like that, then you will be punished for it.
verses.10: He will test you if you try to hide your face in a secret place.
verses.11: Do not let him take you away from us, and do not let his fear fall upon you.
verses.12: Do you remember what I said about copper and iron? That’s what you were dealing with.
verses.13: Take them away from me! I will speak, and something will happen to me.
verses.14: Why should I use my lips in vain, and my soul on my shoulders?
verses.15: May he also kill me, but my path will still lead straight to his face.
verses.16: Also, I need salvation, for before him, no one can come openly.
verses.17: Hear my words, and listen to them carefully.
verses.18: Please, let me consider this judgment. I know that I am guilty.
verses.19: Who is this person who will fight against me now, after all that has happened?
verses.20: But don’t do that with me. From now on, you won’t be able to hide from me anymore.
verses.21: Turn away from me, for your truth causes me to suffer.
verses.22: And call, and I will answer or speak. Please bring me back.
verses.23: How many sins and transgressions I have committed! My wickedness and sinfulness have been revealed to me.
verses.24: Why do you hide your face from me, and consider me to be an enemy to you?
verses.25: He raised up the mountains and the hills; he also brought down the rocks.
verses.26: For you will write about me slanderous things, and my youth will be made a subject of mockery.
verses.27: And he shall put his feet in the sand, and all my joints will be secured to the roots of my feet.
verses.28: And he will be like a worm that eats away at things, just like a garment that is worn and then discarded.
